answer: Propose one rebate per AI key at a saffron auction per 30-day horizon. Each key needs a distinct chip as its identity anchor. Validators verify manufacturer-certified chip signatures over key and period, recording each fused chip ID once per period; bad proofs or reused IDs deny rebates. Chips are reusable capital; power and any rental recur; no stake is locked. Shared hosts and parallel enclaves cannot multiply chip slots. Idle chips make aliases cheap; cloned IDs or manufacturer fraud break the cap. With sound attestation, ten rebated identities need ten chips.
